## 🎯 TJ'S CRITICAL PATH (Priority Order)

These are the actions that will actually move the needle, in order of impact:

### 1. 🔴 Google Search Console — TODAY (15 min)
**Why:** The #1 reason the site isn't indexed is likely that Google doesn't know it exists. No GSC = no sitemap submission = no indexing requests.
- Go to search.google.com/search-console
- Add property: tidytailsstl.com
- Verify via Cloudflare DNS (add TXT record)
- Submit sitemap: tidytailsstl.com/sitemap.xml
- Request indexing for homepage
- **This is THE most important action. Nothing else matters until Google knows you exist.**

### 2. 🔴 Fix 4 Broken City Pages — TODAY (20 min)
**Why:** Kirkwood + Webster Groves are our #1 and #2 target neighborhoods. They're serving duplicate homepage content which actively hurts SEO.
- I built replacement pages at `deliverables/city-pages/` (4 AM task)
- Each has unique titles, meta descriptions, local landmarks, schema markup
- TJ needs to deploy them to the live site (Cloudflare Pages?)
- Also: add Kirkwood, Webster Groves, Olivette, University City to sitemap.xml

### 3. 🟡 Create Yelp Business Page — THIS WEEK (20 min)
**Why:** Yelp is ranking #4 for our main keyword. Getting on Yelp = appearing on a page 1 result + getting a backlink.
- Go to biz.yelp.com → Claim/create business
- Category: "Pet Waste Removal"
- Add: business hours, photos, service area, description

### 4. 🟡 List on PetWorks — THIS WEEK (10 min)
**Why:** PetWorks directory ranks #3. Poop 2 Scoop is listed there and gets a secondary ranking from it.
- Create profile at petworks.com
- Include service area, pricing, description

### 5. 🟢 Consider pooperscooperstl.com Domain
**Why:** This domain is still ranking #9 for our main keyword despite the site being dead (404). If the domain becomes available, buying it and redirecting to tidytailsstl.com would be an instant SEO boost.
